max relative frequency difference against solve_plate_vibration
gates.reference: TensorFEM library entry point on the coarsest level

gates.quantity: near-zero eigenvalues filtered out at the finest mesh
gates.reference: supported boundary must carry no mechanism
gates.note: non-zero means the SRI shear rule still leaves a mechanism in the supported spectrum; reported, and the retained set is verified positive

limitations: Kirchhoff is the yardstick; at a/h = 100 the Mindlin shear correction is O((h/a)^2) ~ 2e-4 relative, far below the 1 % gate but non-zero
hard simple support (w = 0 and the normal rotation restrained) is the library's declared convention; the difference to the soft (SS1) convention is O((h/a)^2) as well
isotropic, uniform thickness, no prestress, no added mass, no damping, no fluid coupling
the selective-reduced-integration shear rule leaves zero-energy mechanisms in the element; the count at each level is reported and the retained spectrum is asserted positive
the reported order is a two-level estimate per mode; it is not a p-refinement study and does not extrapolate the frequencies
